earnings.title: The Travelers Companies, Inc.
highlights: Third Quarter 2026 Net Income per Diluted Share of $9.04 and Core Income per Diluted Share of $9.18
Third quarter net income of $1.917 billion and core income of $1.947 billion.

New York, October 16, 2026 — The Travelers Companies, Inc. today reported net income of $1.917 billion, or $9.04 per diluted share, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to $1.888 billion, or $8.24 per diluted share, in the prior year quarter.

quotes.text: We are pleased to report excellent third quarter results.
quotes.by: Alan Schnitzer, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer

items.heading: Personal Insurance Catastrophe Excess-of-Loss Reinsurance Treaty.
Northeast Property Catastrophe Excess-of-Loss Reinsurance Treaty.
Assessments for Guaranty Funds and Second-Injury Funds and Other Mandatory Assigned Risk and Reinsurance Arrangements.

High levels of catastrophe losses, including as a result of factors such as increased concentrations of insured exposures in catastrophe-prone areas and changing climate conditions, could materially and adversely affect our results of operations, our financial position and/or liquidity, and could adversely impact our ratings, our ability to raise capital and the availability and cost of reinsurance.

If actual claims exceed our claims and claim adjustment expense reserves, or if changes in the estimated level of claims and claim adjustment expense reserves are necessary, including as a result of, among other things, changes in the legal/tort, regulatory and economic environments in which the Company operates, our financial results could be materially and adversely affected.
